findings.description: String filenames are no longer wrapped as a single path, so they are passed to the editor as individual characters. The condition must accept both `str` and `os.PathLike`.
findings.rationale: Calling `click.edit(filename="notes.txt")` now leaves the string unchanged and passes it to `edit_files`, which treats its iterable elements as filenames. The editor therefore opens files named after the individual characters instead of the requested file, breaking the existing string filename API.
